desc: Derive the cut/coverage characterization: strongly connected iff every proper cut has a backward matching edge; forces S_1=B, S_{2N}=W.
Reduce to the inclusion-exclusion recurrence dp[i] = -inv_fact(w_i-i)*sum_{j<i} dp[j]*fact(w_i-j), answer sum dp[i]*fact(N-i).
Cross-check recurrence against brute force for all small N and confirm the 3 public samples.
Implement full solution (factorials + CDQ divide-and-conquer + numpy NTT).
Verify edge cases N=1 (S='BW' -> 1), w_i<i dp zeros, and output 0 when S[0]!='B' or S[-1]!='W'.
Add thresholded direct path to remove the pathological NTT blow-up on small blocks with huge W-runs.

Actually run the solution on the 3 samples (expect 1, 0, 240792) with raw stdout reported; build an independent O(N^2) plain-Python reference of the same recurrence and confirm identical outputs on samples and random small cases; benchmark N=200000 worst cases for runtime/peak memory and report failures exactly.
